mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::text || ':' || coalesce(max(id),0)::text || ':' || coalesce(sum(returned_qty),0)::text || ':' || count(posted_amount)::text || ':' || coalesce(sum(posted_amount),0)::text FROM pur_receipt_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT l.id AS source_id,h.company_id,o.supplier_id AS partner_id,h.warehouse_id,l.sku_id,l.batch_no, (h.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS business_date,l.received_qty-l.returned_qty AS quantity, 0::numeric AS reserved,0::numeric AS locked,0::numeric AS in_transit,l.posted_amount AS amount, coalesce((SELECT sum(r.amount) FROM pur_return r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.source_line_id=l.id AND r.state='FINISHED'),0) AS reduction, 0::numeric AS settled,0::numeric AS paid FROM pur_receipt_line l JOIN pur_receipt h ON h.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND h.id=l.receipt_id JOIN pur_order o ON o.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND o.id=h.order_id WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.id>#{afterId} ORDER BY l.id LIMIT #{limit}
